text: The Lozeine Applied Research Lab is headed by Vambi Herganen, works out of the Tupalhasa Field Office, and operates on an annual budget of $5.0M. It is responsible for incident response tooling, owns Project Dernelnar, and developed the Zartesis Prism. Megen Tissefam is a member of the lab, and its cost center is VR-4757-J with an audit finding ID of VU-5130-Q.
